trust_decision.summary: The admin language editor gate checks only that (int)$_GET['edit_language'] matches an existing language, then the template echoes the raw GET value into a hidden input's value attribute without escaping (SmartyBC with no auto-escape).

landing_point.why: The summary names edit_language and language_settings.php. The handler reads the parameter there and includes language_edit.html, where the raw echo is one grep away.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /admin_area/language_settings.php and POST /admin_area/actions/language_update.php (via display_language_edit, upload/includes/functions_template.php:161-165); value comes from the DB row's integer language_id, so this is hardening only

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver could argue that the raw language_name/language_code echoes in the same form are stored values written by a trusted admin, not the reflected GET parameter the report names.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The hidden edit_language field must keep carrying the numeric language id, so the search form (GET, action='?') returns to the same language editor. Removing the field or blanking it breaks phrase search and pagination.

O6_input_shapes: string GET parameter with a numeric prefix that passes the (int) existence check plus a markup suffix (closed by the (int) cast in the template)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: language_name is echoed raw into the value attribute of the edit form (stored, set via Language::update_lang)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The value is stored, not reflected, and it is written only by an admin with basic_settings permission, so a solver could call it self-XSS.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: language_code is echoed raw into the value attribute of the edit form (stored, set via update_lang/add_lang without validation, upload/includes/classes/lang.class.php:353-365)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as above: an admin-written stored value, not the reported GET parameter.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The breadcrumb URL is built from $_GET['edit_language'] through display_clean. A copy that drops display_clean, or a breadcrumb template that renders url raw, would be a second reflected route for the same parameter.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same parameter already feeds the breadcrumb at this line; a maintainer building the URL by concatenation could easily skip escaping.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The AJAX re-render path (actions/language_update.php) could assign a request-derived search or language value into language_edit.html, so the same template is reached from a second entry point.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: display_language_edit already re-renders this template from $_POST['language_id'] after an update.

O9_family: XSS (reflected, HTML attribute context, Smarty template without auto-escape)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP with vendored composer deps (upload/composer.json, upload/vendor)
O10_build.project_tests: None found: the only phpunit config is vendored (upload/vendor/phpmailer/phpmailer/phpunit.xml.dist); the project has no tests for the admin language pages.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap {$smarty.get.edit_language} in display_clean() or (int) at language_edit.html:40 only, and leave the raw DB-sourced attributes at lines 8 and 25.

out_of_scope_notes: Other admin templates echo request values raw (e.g. upload/admin_area/styles/cb_2014/layout/maintenance.html:78, upload/admin_area/styles/cb_2014/layout/manage_items.html:1, upload/admin_area/styles/cb_2014/layout/template_editor.html:87, upload/admin_area/styles/cb_2014/layout/blocks/advanced_photo_search.html:14). These are different pages and parameters and were not pursued.
upload/admin_area/styles/cb_2014/layout/language_settings.html:47 echoes language_key raw from the DB; this is a stored value, not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell); repo includes upload/vendor.
present_in_latest unknown: no latest release was provided.

The O8 entries are stored, admin-written values, so whether they fall under the advisory's reflected-XSS property is a judgement call. If they are excluded, the advisory has one reflected route (the fix at line 9 only hardens the DB integer id), the single_site red flag applies, and pattern_fit is none.
